test_title: PYST 6: SSC MTS 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 04 Sept, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) if the following figure series were to be continued? 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b1cee572334e139d2ec1c5f619fcbbaa434843d8f144ac0aae65e7e22943ae31.png]
solution:
The figure that will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series is shown below:

1) **For top center element and bottom left corner element :**

 
• Top center element shifts to bottom center positions and back to original positions subsequently.
 
• Bottom left corner element shifts to top right corner position and back to original positions subsequently.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/80e269f0c5bac47781a5baf41006769faf89d219b18d4ba7d942579aac3d3c3c.png] 

2) **For 'O', '3' and '=' elements :**

 
• Alternately center element shifts to bottom left corner position starting with first box.
 
• Alternately top right corner element shifts to center position starting with first box.
 
• Alternately center element is replaced by new element and remains constant starting with second box i.e ' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/44dbec01603cbbaa70c3202599eba6273f4a280fba0bdd0ef4a0b7a03ec17e87.png] ' is replaced by ' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bf1d30eb467efb4182d2e458b3a15dd14b6e971dd4df053e2462fb62c258e67f.png] ' and ' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2f0b890c8565cd069d85c4ce95f26ad152b5d11b13925fc5d59a163f2ca5172a.png] ' is replaced by ' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/88defb15ae2296429147f059b5642260c5f4d3b1a7f5618f17a9ce199c58d96f.png] '.
 
• Alternately top center element shifts to top right corner position starting with second box.
 
• Alternately bottom left corner element shifts to bottom center position starting with second box.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5b3bb1a09b58eb316c79e722ccfea43cf003b749fe870069c3695b08a2e50242.png] 

The final series is :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6b118f369ffa8d06584f0ee2cbc28e139bcffbe349301f6e018fd22b29517683.png] 

Hence, ‘option - (3)’ is the correct answer.
